info.name: Amazon Connect Service Agent Statuses Contacts API

description.content:
Amazon Connect is a cloud-based contact center service. The API provides programmatic access to create and manage contact center instances, users, routing profiles, contact flows, queues, hours of operation, security profiles, and real-time and historical metrics for customer engagement operations.
